title: Scoped security acceptance: SAML assertion replay protection, RBAC templates, audit retention & HSM rotation criteria
creator: Aisha Patel
description: PRD addendum: define unambiguous acceptance criteria, phase gates, and operator runbook artifacts for Private deployment security controls. Focus areas: (1) SAML/SOAP assertion replay protection and session lifetime alignment with customer IdP policies; (2) standardized RBAC templates that map to customer org roles and least-privilege mappings for operator/tenant separation; (3) audit logging schema, retention tiering (30/90/365 days), and export formats for SIEM ingestion; (4) KMS/HSM rotation, emergency key-escrow procedures, and verification steps for on-prem HSMs. The goal is to produce artifact-level signoffs (checklists, MTR tests, and runbook snippets) that allow Security, SRE, and Sales Engineering to validate customer readiness during onboarding and during compliance audits.
scope_changes: Since initial PRD: removed generic 'audit evidence package' language and replaced with concrete logging schema + SIEM export examples; added HSM rotation simulation tests requested by SRE; tightened SSO acceptance to include assertion replay tests and signed-authn request validation; excluded end-user UX changes to console (will be tracked as a follow-up PM ticket).
acceptance_criteria: SSO: Successful test harness demonstrating rejection of replayed SAML assertions (test vector doc + pass/fail logs), and SAML metadata ingestion for at least Okta and Azure AD.
RBAC: Delivery of three role templates (Tenant-Admin, App-Operator, Read-Only-Audit) with documented least-privilege policies and an automated validator that flags overly-broad grants.
Audit: Structured log schema v1.2 published (fields, timestamps, event-codes) and end-to-end export to a test Splunk instance verifying ingestion and integrity checks for 90-day retention tier.

KMS/HSM: Key rotation runbook that performs a staged rotation (primary -> secondary -> rollback) in a dry-run environment with signed attestations; HSM integration verified against a simulated Thales/PKCS11-compatible appliance.
Operator Runbook: Clear escalation steps for key compromise, SSO outage, and audit discovery with sample commands and expected monitoring signals (pager thresholds).
Documentation: Confluence artifacts with step-by-step signoff checklist and checklist owner for each item; all artifacts linkable from onboarding flow in Console.
signoff_checklist: Security review: formal review meeting with Security authored minutes and explicit approval line
SRE validation: runbook smoke tests green in staging and logs shipped to test SIEM
Compliance: legal confirms retention commitments and export formats
SalesEng: validated tenant onboarding demo with RBAC templates applied
Engineering: open blocking bugs for these criteria resolved or triaged with mitigation plan
test_plan: SAML replay test: generate signed assertion, replay after changed NotOnOrAfter -> expect 401 and documented error code [SAML-ERR-REPLAY]
Metadata rotation: rotate IdP metadata and validate automatic refresh + test false-positive detection
RBAC fuzzing: run grant-minimizer against templates and report any excessive resource permissions
Audit export: push 10k synthetic events into staging, pull into Splunk indexer and validate field mapping + checksum pass
HSM rotation dry-run: simulate rotation, verify token counters, and confirm decryption of historical blobs post-rotation
decisions: Prefer event-driven export for audit pipeline (vs batch pull) to preserve ordering guarantees
Adopt PKCS#11 reference tests for HSM verification; no vendor-specific SDK in core runtime
30/90/365 retention tiers by default with option for customer overrides under enterprise contract
risks_mitigations: Risk: SAML assertion replay across time skew -> Mitigation: enforce tighter clock skew policy + test harness to simulate NTP drift
Risk: HSM vendor variance causing integration breakage -> Mitigation: maintain a small compatibility test matrix and require vendor adapter abstraction
Risk: Large audit volumes increase egress cost -> Mitigation: tier retention and sampling policy; provide cost-estimate to customer during onboarding
